issues.t: 12V battery warning or dead 12V battery
issues.sym: A '12V battery needs service' alert, the vehicle won't wake up or unlock, error messages pile up, or it won't go into drive even though the main battery is charged.
issues.why: The small 12V battery runs the computers and locks. Early trucks had a software bug that drained it while parked, and on Gen 2 (2025 and later) vehicles a mounting bracket under the passenger seat can corrode and damage the battery case. Faulty 12V distribution parts have also been replaced.
issues.next: Make sure the latest software is installed and contact Rivian service if the alert stays on. Rivian has been replacing 12V batteries and brackets on affected vehicles.

issues.t: Drive unit failure and sudden loss of power
issues.sym: A critical battery or drive system alert, then the vehicle loses power, sometimes with the rear wheels locking. It usually needs a tow.
issues.why: Owners have reported failed rear and front drive units (motor, gearbox and inverter). Causes reported by service include a shorted wiring harness and a coolant gasket leak that damaged the rear inverter.
issues.next: If an alert appears, steer to a safe spot right away and call Rivian roadside. Drive units are covered by the 8-year drivetrain warranty.

issues.t: Loss of drive power from high-voltage ground fault (recall)
issues.sym: The vehicle may suddenly lose drive power.
issues.why: A connection inside the high-voltage distribution box may not have been grounded properly. Recall 25V-537 repairs the ground strap or replaces the battery pack.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls in the Rivian app or on NHTSA's site and book the free repair.

issues.t: Rear toe link joint can separate after service (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, the vehicle wandering, or in the worst case a rear wheel steering out of line and loss of control.
issues.why: Technicians who separated and refitted the rear toe link joint using an older service procedure may not have reassembled it correctly. Recall 26V-003 replaces the bolts, and NHTSA has opened a probe into toe link separation.
issues.next: If your vehicle had rear suspension service before March 2025, book the free recall repair now. Get any new rear clunk or wandering checked right away.

issues.t: Battery coolant leak under the vehicle
issues.sym: A puddle of coolant under the vehicle, sometimes followed by warnings or a no-drive condition.
issues.why: Coolant circulates through the battery pack and drive units. Owners have reported leaks needing a tow, and one leak at a gasket shorted the rear inverter.
issues.next: Don't drive if there's a coolant puddle and a warning. Contact Rivian service and arrange a tow.

issues.t: Second-row seat belt retractor bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing you can see. In a crash, a rear seat belt might not hold properly.
issues.why: Bolts holding the second-row seat belt retractors may not have been tightened properly. Recall 26V-009 inspects and tightens them.
issues.next: Book the free inspection. It's quick and protects rear passengers.

issues.t: Front seat belt anchor bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom. In a crash, a front seat belt anchor might not hold.
issues.why: The D-ring bolts that anchor the front seat belts may not have been installed correctly. Recall 25V-370 inspects and secures them.
issues.next: Check your VIN and book the free inspection.

issues.t: Rearview camera blocked by on-screen alert (recall)
issues.sym: When you shift into reverse, a safety message can cover the backup camera picture.
issues.why: A software issue let a notification sit on top of the rearview image. Recall 26V-597 fixes it over the air.
issues.next: Install the latest software update and look around before backing up.

issues.t: Front turn signals not flashing (recall)
issues.sym: One or both front turn signals stay dark when you signal.
issues.why: The front turn signal lamps can fail. Recall 25V-387 and its expansion 26V-508 inspect and replace them.
issues.next: Walk around and test both signals. Book the free lamp replacement if one fails.

issues.t: Side curtain airbag trim clips damaged after service (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom, but if the upper door-pillar trim was removed and reused during service, the side curtain airbag might not deploy correctly.
issues.why: Reused B- or C-pillar trim panels may have damaged clips. Recall 24V-408 replaces the trim panels.
issues.next: If your vehicle had interior pillar trim removed in service, check for this recall and book it.

issues.t: Front steering knuckle fastener may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Possible clunking or vague steering from the front; in rare cases the upper control arm could separate from the knuckle.
issues.why: The fastener joining the front upper control arm to the steering knuckle may not have been tightened enough. Recall 22V-744 tightens it.
issues.next: Confirm the recall was done. Get any new front clunk or loose steering checked right away.

issues.t: Front seat belt anchors not secured to B-pillar (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom; a front seat belt might not restrain properly in a crash.
issues.why: Front seat belt anchors may not have been fully attached to the B-pillar. Recall 22V-641 inspects and secures them.
issues.next: Check your VIN and book the free inspection if it is still open.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not switch off correctly (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status light may be wrong, or the airbag might stay on with a child seat or child in the front seat.
issues.why: Faults in the passenger occupant sensing system (recall 22V-319, R1T) and the seat belt sensor (recall 23V-109) could misjudge who is sitting there.
issues.next: Keep children in the back seat and confirm both recalls were done.

issues.t: Accelerator release not detected in hot cabin (recall)
issues.sym: In a very hot cabin, the vehicle might not register that you lifted off the accelerator, so auto-hold or Park may not engage.
issues.why: The accelerator pedal sensor could misread in high heat. Recall 23V-883 adds a software update and a free pedal replacement.
issues.next: Confirm the update and pedal replacement were done. Always check the vehicle is in Park before getting out.

issues.t: Defroster controls missing after software update (recall)
issues.sym: After an update, the windshield defrost and defog controls disappeared from the screen.
issues.why: Software release 2023.42.0 knocked out the defroster controls. Rivian pushed a fixed update (recall 23V-783).
issues.next: Make sure your software is current. Don't drive if you can't clear the windshield.

issues.t: Low beams fail to come on in cold weather (recall)
issues.sym: On a cold start, the low beam headlights may not turn on.
issues.why: Headlight control modules can fail to start up in the cold. Recall 25V-085 replaces them.
issues.next: Check your headlights before driving on cold mornings and book the free module replacement.

issues.t: Highway Assist may misread the car ahead (recall)
issues.sym: With Hands-Free Highway Assist on, the vehicle may not correctly track the vehicle in front.
issues.why: Software before version 2025.18.30 could fail to identify a lead vehicle. Recall 25V-585 fixes it over the air.
issues.next: Install the update and stay ready to brake whenever driver assistance is on.

issues.t: Headlights aimed too low (recall)
issues.sym: Headlights light up less of the road ahead than they should at night.
issues.why: Headlamps left the factory aimed slightly too low. Recall 24V-367 re-aims them.
issues.next: Book the free headlight aim check.

issues.t: R1S backup lights too dim (recall)
issues.sym: The reverse lights on the R1S don't light up the area behind it well enough.
issues.why: The backup lamps did not meet visibility rules. Recall 23V-233 replaces them.
issues.next: Check for the recall if you own a 2022 or 2023 R1S.

issues.t: Water leaking into the cabin or doors
issues.sym: Wet carpet, water inside a door, or drips in the cabin after rain or a wash.
issues.why: Seal and fit problems let water in. Owners of both early and Gen 2 vehicles have reported leaks.
issues.next: Dry the interior quickly to prevent mold and have Rivian find and reseal the leak under warranty.

issues.t: Loud humming or vibration from air conditioning
issues.sym: A deep hum or vibration through the cabin, often on hot days with A/C on Auto, or a loud heat pump when parked.
issues.why: The A/C compressor and heat pump can be loud. Some owners were helped by a compressor replacement or software update; Rivian has called some noise within spec. A full A/C failure has also been reported on a 2025 R1S.
issues.next: Note when it happens and ask service to check the compressor. If cooling stops entirely, book a repair.

issues.t: Air suspension sagging or height faults
issues.sym: One corner sits low after parking, or the vehicle won't change ride height and shows a suspension warning.
issues.why: Leaks or faults in the air suspension parts. Owners have reported sagging that needed service.
issues.next: Drive gently and book service. Avoid off-road or high speeds if the vehicle sits unevenly.

issues.t: Phone key won't unlock or connect reliably
issues.sym: The doors don't unlock when you walk up, the phone key drops its connection, or locking on walk-away doesn't work.
issues.why: Bluetooth phone key reliability has been a long-running complaint, and software updates haven't fully fixed it.
issues.next: Carry the key card or key fob as a backup. Keep the Rivian app updated and allow it to run in the background.

issues.t: Doors that won't close flush and rattles
issues.sym: Doors that must be slammed, a liftgate that sits out on one side, mismatched trim, squeaks and rattles.
issues.why: Early production fit and finish issues. Some can be adjusted at a service center.
issues.next: List every fit issue and have a service center (not just mobile service) adjust them under warranty.

issues.t: R1T powered tonneau cover jams
issues.sym: The power bed cover stops partway or won't open or close.
issues.why: Owners report the cover's mechanism jamming.
issues.next: Clear any debris from the tracks and contact service if it keeps jamming.
